parameters.object: axis-aligned tiling of an integer-sided square by 38 smaller squares
parameters.perfect: all 38 positive integer square side lengths are distinct
parameters.simple: no proper rectangle is tiled by a subset of at least two component squares
parameters.primitive: greatest common divisor of the 38 square side lengths is 1
parameters.objective: minimum outer square side length over all valid tilings

best_human.provenance: Published Bouwkamp code reconstructed with exact integer skyline placement and validated.
best_human.ai_provenance: Human-authored search result; no AI provenance reported by the cited sources.
best_human.evidence_state: same-parameter construction and exact score reproduced; reported as an upper bound

best_public.provenance: Best order-38 side value located in the checked catalog; the catalog marks order 38 incomplete.
best_public.ai_provenance: No AI provenance reported by the source.
best_public.evidence_state: public construction verified; optimality not established

best_reproduced.provenance: Bouwkamp code parsed by exact integer skyline reconstruction.
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: Task-local independent reproduction of a published human construction.
best_reproduced.evidence_state: valid primitive simple perfect order-38 squared square

frozen_human_baseline.provenance: Exact rebuild of the published Williams 38 352A B-code.

highest_reported.reproduction_status: construction reconstructed and checked; no claim that 352 is optimal

own_search_seed.provenance: Generated by an independent run of the published general 3-network generator and search algorithm, using generated network prefixes and no order-38 catalogue construction.
